egress.terms: CDN-served; free tier has no egress billing. Fair Use Policy applies to media hosting.

tooling: Ghost Content API + Admin API (REST), official JS SDK. Self-hosted Ghost has no file-count or size limit except the web server config: "The upload limit is effectively determined by the web server that's serving your Ghost site."
chaining: The interesting half is not Ghost(Pro) — it is that Ghost's unlimited-file design means a self-hosted Ghost on any free host inherits an unbounded media library. That chains Ghost's admin API to whatever free compute/storage is already available, rather than being storage itself.
limits_note: per-object-cap 5 MB (free/Starter), 100 MB (Publisher), 250 MB (Business), 1 GB (Custom). No file-count cap on any plan. Ghost Fair Use Policy constrains 'other file types made available' — enforcement is the practical ceiling.
